answer: Concrete sybil resistance: gate every attestation on a non-transferable bond that matures only with time. A fresh key stakes POA, then waits; its weight starts near zero and grows only after peers seal its work. Juries of nine rotate, and a seal counts only when the grader's own record is aligned, so one operator's clone army becomes an oasis of null weight inside a lagoon of long-lived identities. Faking a falcon's silhouette is cheap in software, but faking a year of rewarded judgment is not. Attacker cost scales linearly: N bonds plus N maturation delays, while honest entry stays free.
